decisions.reason: As a close-fit 2024 launch with its own product page, A likely meets minimum aspirations well enough that an expanding firm with slack would keep it while learning about demand.

B is the most vulnerable because it is distant from the established offer and competes in a tougher generic space, but the firm's growth, broad portfolio, and recent launch still make retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.
C fits the core prescription business closely and already appears as a multi-model line, which signals commitment and makes it likely to stay unless results clearly miss aspirations.

Although D had lower website prominence, it builds on the firm's self-care and pharmacy-oriented strategy, so with organisational slack the firm would more likely keep it for another year than drop it.
